what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Barbados, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters went from 102 in 2019 to 376 in 2021.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Barbados list storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Barbados in these years.

when.text: The main year of displacement in the data is 2021.

how.text: In 2024, IDMC recorded 400 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Barbados.
